Description

It’s a gel-type toner pad infused with cactus mucilage that quickly soothes and firms the look of enlarged pores caused by puffiness and loose skin, delivering intensive pore care.

Inspired by the cactus’s survival mechanism that retains moisture even in desert conditions, the CACTOX complex provides an instant cooling and contracting effect on contact, helping lower skin temperature and tighten the appearance of pores.

The gel pad adheres closely to the skin to deliver deep hydration, smoothing and refining rough texture caused by excess sebum and impurities. With just one use, you can experience improved inner hydration and visibly refined pores in a daily toner pad.


How to use

STEP 01. Targeted Application
Take out a pad and place it with the gel side against the skin, applying it to areas where pores appear enlarged, such as the butterfly zone or nose.

STEP 02. Refining Care
Use the non-gel side to gently wipe the skin’s surface, removing excess sebum and dead skin cells.

If desired, leave the pad on for 3–5 minutes like a mini mask to enjoy cooling and hydrating soothing care.
